brief:
Israeli Occupation Forces killed 15 Palestinians and wounded others between 19 and 22 November across the Gaza Strip through airstrikes, gunfire attacks, and artillery shelling, the Palestinian Centre for Human Rights reported. The military intensified operations in the central Gaza Strip during the period.

The IOF continued dropping explosive-laden boxes to demolish remaining houses as part of wider destruction operations in the territory.
dek: Between 19 and 22 November 2026, the Israeli Occupation Forces (IOF) killed 15 Palestinians and wounded others in a series of airstrikes, gunfire attacks, and artillery shelling across the Gaza Strip. During this period, the IOF intensified its airstrikes, particularly in the central Gaza Strip, and continued dropping explosive-laden boxes to demolish the remaining houses…
title: Israeli forces kill 15 Palestinians in Gaza airstrikes and artillery fire
